title: Charlie Carpenter, lyrics for Blue Because of You, Harlem Lament
summary: Carpenter and Louis Dunlap wrote words; Wilson explains how he wrote Harlem Lament.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Charlie Carpenter was the -- Earl's personal secretary and valet for the band.
He wrote some tunes, too, some lyrics?
He also -- Charlie Carpenter and Louis Dunlap also wrote the lyrics for my tune, "Blue Because of You."
Was that your title, or theirs?

I don't know whose. Must have been their title, because they wrote the words. I wrote the music, first. I didn't figure on, you know, publishing or nothing like that. I just wrote it for a recording session.
Yeah, that had some nice parallel voicings in one section that wasn't done much at that time.
No. I got that idea just sitting at the piano, messing around on the piano.
Yeah, I like parallel voice. You get a very open sound.
It was a nice contrast with the rest of the arrangement.
